title: Karl Wolfe run over before disclosure wave

tellings.quote: of so-called disclosure began in 2017, 2018, poor Carl Wolf was run over just the way John Mack was run over,

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels that just as "so-called disclosure," the push for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, began in 2017 and 2018, a man named Karl Wolfe "was run over just the way John Mack was run over." Jorjani sets the two deaths side by side to suggest that people tied to the subject die in the same way at telling moments.
